comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item can be crafted in one of two ways.

Method #1: Bremen - Recipe Book Making Mercenary Clothes Item Shop; Required World Clock Age: 15C 4, 15C 5 or Age Effect Item (15C or 16C)

Skills: R15 Sewing / R13 Alchemy
Ingredients: Luxury Flax Yarn x1 + Ancient Iron Meteorite x1 + Axe Fragment x1
Result: Custom Flax Yarn

Method #2: Acropolis of Atlantis - Recipe Book "Making Special Yarn" Item Shop; only accessible when Atlantis is present in the server

R15 Sewing / R14 Handicrafts
Luxury Flax Yarn x1 + Axe Fragment x1
Result: Custom Flax Yarn

Obviously the Atlantis recipe is more advantageous since it omits the Ancient Iron Meteorite item, but as Atlantis isn't always around, the Bremen recipe book remains the more reliable choice.

As for the uses of this item, it is used in the Mercenary Clothes book to increase particular armors to 100 attack. Refer to the book for more details.

Cheers.
